experiment_type: exploratory discovery on 52 historical development subjects

reference.margin: arithmetic mean of all available frozen KEEP binary margins
reference.unit: one row per dataset x subject x session x manifest trial

keep_only_menu: B2 all-run hard majority with tie->class1
oracle_priority: KEEP first; if wrong, lexicographically first correct candidate within fixed menu
primary_metric: mean subject balanced accuracy and paired subject bootstrap Delta BA vs B6

headroom_gate.state_A_if: strongest action oracle Delta BA < 0.005 OR top-20%-subject concentration >= 0.90 OR STATE C breadth criteria fail after generic-diversity exclusion
headroom_gate.state_B_if: action oracle beats B6 but action-oracle minus KEEP-only-oracle Delta BA < 0.005
